registration.title: SIGNAL v3 -- single confirmatory campaign (the journal run)
registration.lineage_disclosure: PILOT -> PREREGISTER -> CONFIRM. This registration is written AFTER an extensive registered pilot program: v1.1 (cfae5dee...58b8), v1.2 (b9e9cf6e...cdc59), and the executed v2.1 campaign (81d4178d...052d, seeds 25-49, n*=25 fallback). Every prediction below is therefore INFORMED by pilot outcomes and is stated as a risky directional prediction on FRESH seeds; the pilot results (including the falsified v2.1 P2 direction and the dhat forecast-head defect) are disclosed in full in the paper. No cell of this campaign had produced dev or confirmatory data at registration time (chain-validation smokes at total_episodes=30 excluded mechanically by ep-stamped sentinels).
registration.instrument: Frozen v3 codebase (git tag v3.0; hash recorded in reports/V3_RUN_RECORD.md and repair_out/run_meta.json). Post-unblinding repair layer: dhat messages come from a CERTIFIED frozen forecaster (results/forecaster_ar1r9.pt: MSE ratio 1.047 vs empirical conditional benchmark, bias -0.018, pred SD 5.616/5.625, corr .879, slope .994; gate thresholds ratio<=1.10, |bias|<=0.5, slope in [0.8,1.2], corr>=0.8, SD>=50% bench); loader fail-closed on certification; gradient isolation structural (outside the optimizer); legacy arms golden-equivalence tested byte-identical.

seeds.power_note: n=25 honors the v2.1 registered fallback n*=25. Observed pilot effects (V_AR9(raw)=+462, sd~330; C-NULL sd~26 vs band~82) give power ~1.0 for P1' and TOST members; P2' Gamma sd~[pilot 25/25 unanimous]; the binding members are the triangle TOSTs, for which n=25 preserves the v2.1 planning margins.

design.eval: CRN final-eval seed base 500000 (shared with all baselines/references)

primaries_joint_holm_alpha_05.P1prime: V_inf(raw) = C(r4_nocomm) - C(r4_raw) > 0, one-sided paired t (scipy.stats.ttest_1samp, alternative='greater'); BCa CI and Wilcoxon reported. Fresh-seed replication of the pilot's load-bearing AR-leg.
primaries_joint_holm_alpha_05.P2prime: Gamma = V_c12(raw) - V_inf(raw) < 0, one-sided paired t (alternative='less'). DIRECTION IS THE PILOT-LEARNED REVERSAL of the v2.1 registration (pilot: Gamma(12)=-462 [-577,-331], 25/25). Registered mechanism diagnostic: censoring-capture(c12) ~= 0 (M2, learning failure under censoring), computed by the frozen decomposition machinery; diagnostic bounds interpretation, never the decision.
primaries_joint_holm_alpha_05.CNULLprime: Schuirmann TOST: |V_inf(dhatc)| within +/-2% of mean C(r4_nocomm) (scripts.c1_stats.tost). Tests whether the pilot's dhat-redundancy equivalence SURVIVES certification -- the registered reading of Branch A. If instead V_inf(dhatc) rejects >0 one-sided (reported two-sided sensitivity), the reversal is reported as the finding (Branch B) with the equivalence claim withdrawn.
primaries_joint_holm_alpha_05.correction: joint Holm over {P1prime, P2prime, CNULLprime} via scripts.c1_stats.compare_many(method='holm'), familywise alpha=.05

secondaries_one_family_holm.HREPprime: cost(r4_arpred) - cost(r4_raw) TOST within +/-2% band (raw ~ analytic linear predictor: operational-representation equivalence, fresh seeds)
secondaries_one_family_holm.D1prime_learning_tax: cost(r4_dhatc) - cost(r4_arpred): decision tree TOST -> CI+ -> CI- -> inconclusive (certified-learned vs analytic content)
secondaries_one_family_holm.TRANSFER_a: C(raw trained inf, eval c12) - C(raw trained c12, eval c12) > 0 one-sided
secondaries_one_family_holm.TRANSFER_b: C(raw trained c12, eval inf) - C(raw trained inf, eval inf) > 0 one-sided
secondaries_one_family_holm.LADDER_learned: V_inf(learned): decision tree (pilot: null with attribution-gate pass)
secondaries_one_family_holm.correction: Holm within this eight-member family; raw and adjusted p both reported

diagnostics_registered_interpretation_on.optimality_gap: tau grid {.10,.20,.30} vs AR_BestBS regenerated on the v3 eval streams (scripts/baselines.py ar -> results/baselines_ar_v3.json); pilot: raw at gap ~0 -- information-value reading expected to replicate; rule never alters test decisions
diagnostics_registered_interpretation_on.v_distribution: P(V>0), deciles, min/max accompany every primary
diagnostics_registered_interpretation_on.audibility_and_attribution: do(m) gates precede any economic-null language for a channel (frozen v2 machinery)

qmix_exploratory_program.grid: FIXED at executed (n=41, s_max=160); exonerated by the fair grid benchmark (expressiveness +18.8 of +2855, results/qmix_grid_benchmark.json)
qmix_exploratory_program.competence_gate: dev-mean nocomm <= 1.20 x GridCondBS(41,160)=4519.7 AND <= 0.85 x qr_base dev-mean; cheapest passer wins the qrw_{nocomm,raw} pair
qmix_exploratory_program.concordance_rule: sign(V_qmix(raw)) on the winner pair vs sign of P1prime; NO WINNER => V1 reported UNADJUDICABLE (predeclared outcome; no post-hoc tuning); --force* continuations stamped FORCED and excluded from confirmatory language

registration.analysis_binding: All decisions computed by run_repair_study.py analyze from repair_out/v1 and repair_out/transfer dumps: scipy.stats.ttest_1samp (one-sided), scripts.c1_stats.tost (Schuirmann), scripts.c1_stats.bootstrap_ci (BCa, percentile fallback), scripts.c1_stats.compare_many (Holm). Missing cells fail closed. The report (reports/REPAIR_STUDY.md) embeds git hash + this registration's hash.
registration.amendment_policy: Scope extensions (D-DP, D-RHO, D-GEO, D-BETA) require a written amendment to this document, re-hashed, BEFORE any such cell trains. Post-unblinding changes of any registered rule are prohibited; deviations are reported as deviations.
